Logobook - Discover the worlds finest logos, symbols and trademarks

name: Logobook
summary: Curated showcase of logos, symbols and trademarks, organised by shape, object, nature, letter and industry.
description: Logobook is a showcase of logos, symbols and trademarks, all black-and-white vector marks, sorted into letters & numbers, shape, object, nature and business categories with dozens of subcategories (arrows, circles, stars, birds, crowns, banks, sports). Each entry credits the brand and designer where known. Curated by Svizra, an international community of branding designers; logo submissions are currently suspended.
contains: 13,716 URLs in the sitemap, mostly individual logo pages
5 top-level categories: letters & numbers, shape, object, nature, business
shape subcategories include 3D, arrows, circle, cube, dots, hexagon, stars, waves
nature subcategories include birds, faces, fire, flowers, mountains, trees
letter indexes A-Z list logos with their brands and designers
only black-and-white vector logos; submissions are currently suspended
curated by Svizra, an international branding designer community
